gloss.to: to — перед дієсловом: want you to do = хочу, щоб ви зробили
gloss.he’d: він (he’d been expecting = він уже чекав)
gloss.beside: поруч (beside one another = поруч одне з одним)
gloss.fabric: тканинний (fabric couch = диван з тканинною оббивкою)

clips.note: Two men at work are angry with each other. The boss says: shake hands and forget it.
around: Guys, you know what I want you to do?
That was not a shake, Dwight.

clips.note: A fighter tells a story from the past: he and another man shook hands, and he believed him.
Levy watches a chess game. The players stop and shake hands: the game is over.

clips.line: And so at once, we shook hands, and smiled, and I gave him my gift, and he told me I was a guest in his home…
clips.note: Many years ago, a crash left the speaker badly hurt. Now he visits the man who caused it. They shake hands, and the man says he is a guest in his home.
clips.noteUa: Багато років тому оповідач сильно постраждав в аварії. Тепер він приходить до чоловіка, який її спричинив. Вони тиснуть руки, і той каже, що він — гість у його домі.
around: He’d been expecting me, Mohamed had phoned.
and we sat beside one another on a fabric couch.
